name: aicoe-llm
description: Gates the llm gateway (Vertex AI via apigee-llm-runtime) for Translation's and Sales-Agent's own outbound model calls. Internal service-to-service only, no developer portal. Quota attributes here are read by llm-gateway-v1's Q-* policies. llmOperationGroup below IS the enforced model allow-list: Apigee's own credential/operation matching rejects any request whose path+method matches no entry, before any policy in the proxy runs. The vestigial allowed-models KVM enforces nothing and must not be used for this. NOTE: this product intentionally has no top-level "proxies" list -- Apigee rejects a product that sets both that and an llmOperationGroup; the proxy is named by apiSource instead. The three models are not a guess: they are the union actually reachable from Translation's model_selection.json in GCS (150 routes, fallback chains plus A/B variants). gemini-3.5-flash alone would reject every fallback, and fallbacks fire exactly when the primary is struggling. Claude is deliberately absent (D-C) and must also be removed from model_selection.json, or those routes fail here.
